Pui restricted SVG renderer — third-party notices

This directory contains the original license/copyright/author materials shipped
with the 18 new locked crates used by the restricted SVG preview. Source code
was not modified. Dual-license texts are both retained; BSD notices/disclaimers
are included verbatim. manifest.json binds exact versions and file SHA256s.
This is an additive SVG dependency inventory, not an assertion that it covers
every existing Pui, Chromium, font, operating-system or transitive component.

Renderer: https://github.com/linebender/resvg
Geometry types: https://github.com/linebender/svgtypes
The Cargo.lock registry checksums bind the original crate archives.
